title: decision: consent operation/domain violations answer 400 (INVENTED status)
description: protocol-06 §5.7 says the targetUri 'needs to be' in the receiving provider's domains and the requesterUri in the sending provider's (reversed for updateConsent), and gives each endpoint its operations (request/cancel; grant/revoke), but names no status for a violation. mimid answers 400: wrong operation for the endpoint, a URI outside the required domain, the path domain not this provider, or a missing/malformed From (From is a consistency check only, decision .6.9). INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: the status code.
